## This work (Р-251 English series, campaign by the model of «Маски», Р-202/Р-228)

«Horror on the Orient Express» (Chaosium 2014, 2nd edition, 7e; 1st ed. 1991; Geoff Gillan, Mark Morrison, Penelope Love and others) goes into the base whole. No Russian edition exists (the base and the owner's library were checked): the English original is the source, the Russian text is our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py w1 w2 …` (ONE run for all words) and existing records (Р-184); Hard/Extreme roll = «трудная/чрезвычайная проверка». The campaign name in Russian is «Ужас в Восточном экспрессе» (already used in the base). New terms of your pages — one Russian form each, used everywhere, all listed in your coverage file (English → Russian): the page-by-page translation of the books (Р-251, later, by Codex) reuses exactly these forms and your `name.ru`.

### Sources (all registered; printed page = physical − 2 in the six volumes, i.e. `offset −2`; `pages.py show/grep` take printed pages)

- `hotoe-book-1-en` Book I Campaign Book (76 p.), `hotoe-book-2-en` Book II Through the Alps (266 p.), `hotoe-book-3-en` Book III Italy & Beyond (272 p.), `hotoe-book-4-en` Book IV Constantinople & Consequences (194 p.), `hotoe-book-5-en` Book V Strangers on the Train (92 p.), `hotoe-book-6-handouts-en` Book VI Handouts (192 p.: player copies of the handouts and maps of Books I–IV; each page names its source as «BOOK II, PAGE 14»; even pages are blank backs). All have a text layer.
- Scans WITHOUT a text layer (look at page images: `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py image <book> <page> --physical --dpi 60`, one page at a time; OCR with tesseract if you need the labels): `hotoe-keeper-maps-en` Keeper Maps (18 p., hi-res keeper maps: 1 London 1923, 2 London 1893, 3 Paris & western environs, 4 Paris 1923, 5 Lausanne, 6 Milan, 7 Venice, 8 Trieste, 9 Orašac, 10 Vinkovci, 11 Grotte di Postumia, 12 Belgrade, 13 the Dreamlands («Henri's Unusual Train of Dreams»), 14 Sofia, 15 Constantinople 330, 16 Constantinople 1204, 17 Constantinople 1893 (probably — compare with Book II p. 245), 18 Constantinople 1923); `hotoe-player-maps-en` Player Maps (13 p.: 1 London 1923, 2 Paris, 3 Lausanne, 4 Milan, 5 Venice, 6 Trieste, 7 Belgrade, 8 Vinkovci, 9 Sofia, 10 Constantinople 330, 11 Constantinople 1204, 12 Constantinople 1893?, 13 Constantinople 1923); `hotoe-train-car-plans-en` (5 p.), `hotoe-air-routes-en` (1), `hotoe-route-map-en` (1, European route map), `hotoe-scroll-of-the-head-en` (1), `hotoe-sticker-pack-en` (10: luggage stickers, postcards, the simulacrum cut-out), `hotoe-us-passport-en` (2), `hotoe-calendar-1923-en` (4); `hotoe-travelers-companion-en` Travelers' Companion (52 p., text layer, NO printed page numbers: `printed_page` = physical).
- Sources of a record name the book of each page (`book_id`), e.g. a handout: the chapter page in Book II + the player copy in Book VI. Do NOT edit `pipeline/source/books.json`.

### Fixed ids (all units use them; a reference to a record another unit is still writing is expected to fail `check.py` until that unit lands — list such refs in the report, do not drop them)

- Records of a chapter live in the folder of the volume that prints the chapter: `kb/books/<volume>/<kinds>/`, id `<volume>/<kind>/<slug>` (the viewer shows the six volumes as one work, Р-208: `work` = `hotoe-book-1-en`).
- Campaign: `hotoe-book-1-en/scenario/horror-on-the-orient-express` (unit campaign) — `summary`, `keeper_info` (Sedefkar, the simulacrum, Fenalik, the Brothers of the Skin, the Makryats), `hook`, `advice` (running the campaign, survival guide, optional chapters), `steps` = the chapters in order with refs to the stage records (and a step that names «Царство Террора», `tsarstvo-terrora-ru/scenario/reign-of-terror`, as the later «secret chapter» — a ref, not a stage), `conclusion`, `tables`.
- Stages — scenario records with `part_of` = the campaign and `order` (book order; unit campaign may correct `order` by Book I «The Scenarios» p. 42–46 through proposals), optional chapters say so in `advice`: `hotoe-book-2-en/scenario/dancers-in-an-evening-fog` (1, london), `…/the-doom-train` (2, london, optional), `…/the-blood-red-fez` (3, fez, optional, 1893), `…/les-fleurs-du-mal` (4, paris), `…/the-dreamlands-express` (5, dreamlands, optional), `…/nocturne` (6, lausanne-milan), `…/note-for-note` (7, lausanne-milan); `hotoe-book-3-en/scenario/death-and-love-in-a-gondola` (8, venice), `…/the-dark-crusader` (9, crusader, optional, 1204), `…/cold-wind-blowing` (10, trieste, optional), `…/in-a-city-of-bells-and-towers` (11, zagreb-vinkovci, optional), `…/bread-and-stone` (12, zagreb-vinkovci, optional), `…/sanguis-omnia-vincet` (13, sanguis, optional, 330), `…/little-cottage-in-the-wood` (14, belgrade); `hotoe-book-4-en/scenario/repossession` (15, sofia), `…/by-the-skin-of-the-teeth` (16, constantinople), `…/blue-train-black-night` (17, return), `…/the-fog-lifts` (18, return), `…/the-simulacrum-unbound` (19, modern, optional, 2013). ### Places (Р-190, Р-209)

- Shared cities `kb/locations/<slug>.json` (id `coc:location:<slug>`, `location_type: город`, `part_of: null`, model `kb/locations/cairo.json`). **Existing — never rewrite, proposals only:** `london` (Masks districts exist: `masks-of-nyarlathotep-en/location/england-westminster`, `england-city-of-london`, `england-soho`, `england-mayfair`, `england-chelsea`, `england-covent-garden`, `england-st-pancras`, `england-limehouse`, `england-southwark`, `england-london-environs`; shared `coc:location:holborn`, `lambeth`, `british-museum`… — put London places under the district where they stand), `paris` (from «Царство Террора»: link its places — `tsarstvo-terrora-ru/location/paris-royal-library` = the Bibliothèque Nationale, `paris-charenton-asylum`, `paris-environs` (Western Environs go under it), `1789-poissy` (Poissy) — and propose 1923 facts for them), `milan` (from «Лохмотья Короля»: `lokhmotya-korolya-ru/location/milan-*` exist — link, do not duplicate), Dreamlands `ulthar`, `dylath-leen`, `celephais` (other Dreamlands lands and cities of the chapter — book records `dream-…`, Р-190). **New, each made only by its unit:** `lausanne` (lausanne-milan), `venice` (venice), `trieste` (trieste; Postumia under the book area `trieste-environs`), `zagreb` (zagreb-vinkovci, only if the chapter describes the real city; the dream city of bells is a book record `zagreb-city-of-bells`, `город`, `part_of: null`, refs to the real city), `vinkovci` (zagreb-vinkovci), `belgrade` and `orasac` (belgrade), `sofia` (sofia; the Iskur caves under the book area `sofia-environs`), `constantinople` (constantinople — one record for all eras: name «Константинополь», aliases «Стамбул», «Istanbul», «Византий», «Нова Рома»; fez (1893), crusader (1204), sanguis (330) and modern (2013) put their places under it with their own prefixes and link the city id (expected to fail until it lands); the Lydian frontier of 330 is a top area `sanguis-lydian-frontier`, `область`, `part_of: null`). A town en route that a unit needs but nobody owns (Calais, Dijon, Salzburg, Adrianople…) — Grep `kb/locations`; if it is missing, write the city draft into `checks/20261127-hotoe/new-shared-locations-<unit>.json` (the lead creates it) and give a short line in the stage `steps` meanwhile.
- Under each city — districts by the map, places in the district where they stand; one area «Окрестности <города>» per city for places outside it (book record `<prefix>-<city>-environs`, unless one exists); list captions (`keeper_hint`) neutral — no secrets, clues or outcomes (Р-209). Historic places of another era in the same city (London 1893, Constantinople 330/1204/1893) — book places with the era in the name when they differ («Константинополь 1204: Красная башня»).

### Maps (Р-206) and pictures (Р-241, Р-245)

- Every keeper map of your chapter → `map` record `<volume>/map/<prefix>-<slug>`: image from the hi-res Keeper Maps PDF when it has that map, else the book page (render `pdftoppm -r 150-200`, crop with PIL, save `app/maps/hotoe-<unit>-<slug>.jpg`, quality 85, ≤ 2000 px wide), `width`/`height`, `location` = the city or area, `shows` = the place, spots on every printed number and label (tesseract `tsv`, each checked by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. The players' version (Player Maps PDF or Book VI) → a second `map` record `<prefix>-<slug>-players` with the same spot targets (model `kb/books/star-on-the-shore-en/maps/rockport-player-map.json`). `sources` of a map — every page that prints it: the chapter page, the «Complete Maps» page of the volume, the Keeper/Player Maps page, the Book VI page.
- Handouts: the text as printed (English) + our full translation; the picture of the player copy from Book VI (crop) to `images` (kind `handout`) through `pipeline/art/add_images.py`; sources — chapter page + Book VI page. Portraits, creature art, item pictures — skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`: mapping `checks/20261127-hotoe/art-<unit>.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real, apply your proposals (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) for your own records; atmosphere pictures → `checks/20261127-hotoe/atmosphere-<unit>.json` (the lead merges). Picture file prefix: `hotoe-<unit>-`.

### Writing and checks

- Statblocks as printed (Р-25); misprints kept as printed, in `errata` (Р-35), an obvious fix in `corrections`; dice `1d6` with lowercase d; distances metric even in quotes (Р-64), money as printed; `axes.era` ["1920s"]; the 1893 chapter ["gaslight"], 1204 ["dark-ages"], 330 ["other"] (Cthulhu Invictus — say «330 год, Константинополь» in the summary), 2013 ["modern"]; `axes.ruleset` "core".
- Coverage: `checks/20261127-hotoe/<unit>.md` — every heading of your pages → record(s), «не взято» with the reason (indexes, Kickstarter lists, blank «Keeper's Entries» forms — say so), misprints, the term list English → Russian. Proposals `checks/20261127-hotoe/proposals-<unit>.json`.
- Helper scripts only in `.cache/lead-tools/gen-hotoe-<unit>/`; paths computed from `__file__` or the repository root; library root from `pipeline/source/library.json`; never hardcoded.
- Memory rule (owner): the PC's RAM must stay below 85 % — never run python processes in parallel; terms in ONE run (`python -B tools/terms.py w1 w2 …` or `--file`); page images one at a time; render the big Keeper/Player Maps scans one page at a time.
- When done: `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books <your volume> --out checks/20261127-hotoe/completeness-<unit>` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books <your volume> --out checks/20261127-hotoe/scenario-<unit>` (other units' gaps are expected — fix and report only yours); `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/<your volume>` — 0 errors in your files.
- Order: all units except companion may run in parallel (by the memory rule); companion runs after the chapter units (it adds the Travelers' Companion to the cities they made).
